title: 第13章 武王一枪一个第14章 晋级混沌空间第三层
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
“八小姐，大事不好了！”
“王爷一个护卫没带，一个人驾车出城了！”
王大年焦急的冲进沈慕戎的房间。
沈慕戎噌的一下站起来：“昨日才经历刺杀！那刺客不敢再来公爵府，可不代表不敢在城外杀人啊！”
“小弟有危险！娘，跟我一起去保护小弟！”
沈虹拦住沈慕戎：“你在外人看来，已经死了。”
“换一套甲士的衣服去！”
……
马车冲出大夏龙都后，顺着官道一路向西而去。
唐妙衣骑马追上来：“叶凡，不能再往前了！”
“你不怕继续被人刺杀吗？”
叶凡笑道：“我就是等人来刺杀我！”
“你疯了吗？”
唐妙衣以为自己听错了。
叶凡扫了她一眼：“想不想知道箱子里的东西是什么？”
“想！”
“那就来帮我驾车！”
叶凡放慢马车速度，直接掀开门帘钻进去。
唐妙衣没办法拒绝，马车无人驾驶，搞不好会失控，她翻身跳上马车，一边驾车一边对着叶凡叫道：“现在去哪里？”
“往人少的地方去！”叶凡回答。

“你一定是疯了！”
唐妙衣深吸一口气，心跳加速！哪怕她不是大夏朝堂的人，也知道有多少人想要叶凡死！沈慕戎已经死了，北境八十万大军群龙无首，这时候镇北王叶凡如果死掉，镇北王一脉将彻底断绝。
到时候八十万大军落入谁手，谁就可能是下一任大夏皇帝！
马车疾驰半个时辰后，两道身影挡在前方。
百米之外，二人身穿黑色夜行衣，蒙面。
一股杀气扑面袭来，唐妙衣拉紧缰绳，两个马蹄腾空，重重落在地上，马车趁势停下。
唐妙衣回头对马车里说道：“是两个武王！起码六阶以上。”
她是二阶大武师，境界不高，无法察觉到两人的具体境界！
但绝对是六阶以上的武王！
“割断缰绳，把马赶走！”
叶凡命令。
唐妙衣有些生气，甚至忘记二人的身份差距，怒道：“都什么时候了，你还在想这些！我要被你害死了！”
这些人要杀叶凡，她在现场，一定会被灭口！
叶凡低喝一声：“快割！”
唐妙衣拔出匕首，割断马身上的缰绳，又在马屁股上划了一刀！
马长啸一声，快速冲进树林消失。
content_en:
"Miss Eighth, something serious has happened!"
"Your Majesty drove out of the city alone without any bodyguards!"
Wang Danian rushed into Shen Murong's room anxiously.
Shen Murong suddenly stood up: "I just experienced the assassination yesterday! The assassin doesn't dare to come to the Duke's Mansion again, but that doesn't mean he doesn't dare to kill people outside the city!"
"My little brother is in danger! Mom, come with me to protect my little brother!"
Shen Hong stopped Shen Murong: "In the eyes of outsiders, you are already dead."
"Change into a set of soldier's clothes!"
…
After the carriage rushed out of Daxia Longdu, it headed west along the official road.
Tang Miaoyi rode up to catch up: "Ye Fan, we can't go any further!"
"Aren't you afraid of being assassinated again?"
Ye Fan smiled and said: "I'm just waiting for someone to assassinate me!"
"Are you crazy?"
Tang Miaoyi thought she heard wrongly.
Ye Fan glanced at her: "Do you want to know what's in the box?"
"Think!"
"Then come and help me drive!"
Ye Fan slowed down the carriage, opened the door curtain and got in.
Tang Miaoyi couldn't refuse. The carriage was unmanned and might lose control. She turned over and jumped on the carriage. While driving, she shouted to Mark: "Where are we going now?"
"Go to a place with few people!" Ye Fan replied.
"You must be crazy!"
Tang Miaoyi took a deep breath and her heart beat faster! Even if she is not from Daxia Court, she still knows how many people want Ye Fan to die! Shen Murong is dead, and the 800,000-strong army in the north is leaderless. If Ye Fan, King of Zhenbei, dies at this time, the line of King of Zhenbei will be completely cut off.
Whoever the 800,000-strong army falls into at that time may be the next Emperor of Great Xia!
After the carriage galloped for half an hour, two figures blocked the front.
A hundred meters away, two people were wearing black night clothes and covering their faces.
A murderous aura hit him, Tang Miaoyi tightened the reins, two horse hooves flew into the air, and landed heavily on the ground. The carriage took advantage of the situation and stopped.
Tang Miaoyi turned back to the carriage and said, "They are two Martial Kings! At least six levels above."
She is a second-level great martial artist, her realm is not high, and she cannot detect the specific realm of the two of them!
But he is definitely a Martial King of level six or above!
"Cut the reins and drive the horse away!"
Ye Fan ordered.
Tang Miaoyi was a little angry, even forgetting the identity gap between the two, and said angrily: "It's been so long, and you are still thinking about this! I am going to be killed by you!"
These people want to kill Ye Fan. If she is present, she will be silenced!
Ye Fan shouted: "Quickly cut!"
Tang Miaoyi pulled out the dagger, cut off the horse's reins, and slashed the horse's butt!
The horse roared loudly and quickly rushed into the woods and disappeared.
